class.name: AudioStreamMedia
class.description: Plays the audio a [MediaSource] decodes (stereo, already at the mix rate). [method AudioStreamPlayer.get_playback_position] is the media time of the audio mixed, so [code]get_playback_position() + AudioServer.get_time_since_last_mix() - AudioServer.get_output_latency()[/code] is the A/V master clock. When no audio is decoded yet the playback outputs silence and the position stays put. [member AudioStreamPlayer.pitch_scale] is ignored. Get one with [method MediaSource.get_audio_stream].
